numerical_contract: Final outputs meet justified rtol/atol. No blanket intermediate exactness, serial FP order, no-FMA rule or no-FTZ rule. Exact integer/address/transport behavior remains mandatory.
marked_operator_policy: Supported extensions are targeted unless they exercise an independently retained core invariant; starred operators are not mandatory solely by being present.
